query:
SELECT id FROM "Client"
                       WHERE (("expireAt" IS NOT NULL AND "expireAt" <= $1)
                           OR ("trafficLimit" > 0 AND "usedTraffic" >= "trafficLimit")
                           OR "restrictionReason" IS NOT NULL
                           OR ("nextTrafficResetAt" IS NOT NULL AND "nextTrafficResetAt" <= $1)
                           OR ("trafficResetDay" IS NOT NULL AND "nextTrafficResetAt" IS NULL))
                         AND ($2::text IS NULL OR id > $2::text)
                       ORDER BY id ASC
                       LIMIT 100
